summary.text: Nathan Wood is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a coach.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Wood earned a high school diploma through homeschooling and a bachelor's degree from Alfred University, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Wood said legislative reform was needed to address what he called corruption and indolence he witnessed while serving at the House, and he called for banning gifts to legislators and increasing transparency.

He also said he supports a moratorium on data centers while environmental and ratepayer protections are created, and that Pennsylvania should promote fair wages, labor protections and progressive tax structures to fund health care, transportation and education.
Wood listed the South Central Pennsylvania Young Democrats as an endorser.
